admission.justification: Repairing the five producers in the pinning leaf against pinning them with named owners was the measured choice the rulings decided both sides of.

alternatives.option: Pin the five in the tests with their owners named; L111 and L110 repair and empty the pins.
alternatives.reason: d246006f: the failures belong to L111/L110 answers, so the pinning leaf repairs no producer; 448f carries the measured hunks byte-for-byte.

alternatives.option: Repair the five producers inside the pinning leaf.
alternatives.reason: Would make the pinning leaf own L111/L110 answers, against the task exclusion on producer repair.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An owning leaf repair lands; the pin entry goes with it in the same change (d246006f condition).

consequences: The five are pinned with owners, never repaired in the pinning leaf.
L130 pin hunks stay byte-identical to measured copies until the owning leaf repairs its surface (448f, hash-reviewed).
